name: gimli-auto-aranges
instr:
Please make gimli in `/app` generate `.debug_aranges` from compilation-unit coverage. Don't add new crates.

Expose `gimli::write::DebugAranges<W: Writer>(pub W)` with the standard writable-section API and `gimli::write::Sections::debug_aranges: DebugAranges<W>`, including new/get/get_mut/for_each/for_each_mut, once per visitor (order unspecified).

Add public fields `gimli::write::Unit::aranges_include_children: bool` and `gimli::write::Unit::aranges_include_lines: bool`, both initially false, including converted units. Always select root coverage; optionally union every reachable descendant's coverage, regardless of tag. Ignore detached subtrees. Per DIE, `DW_AT_ranges` wins, even empty; otherwise use low_pc/high_pc, omitting incomplete pairs. Selected forms must be `RangeListRef`, `Address` low_pc, and `Address`/`Udata` high_pc; otherwise `Error::InvalidAttributeValue`. Address high_pc is exclusive; Udata is length.

Resolve every `Range` variant. `OffsetPair` uses the latest `BaseAddress`, initially that DIE's low_pc or constant zero, never its parent's. `StartEnd`/`StartLength` are absolute without changing base. Endpoint domains must match: constants or identical symbols. Sort constants before numeric symbol IDs, then starts (signed addends); merge overlap, duplicates and adjacency only within domains.
